controls.name: actual-identified-setuid-ps-kill
controls.missing_prerequisite: A positively owned, unreaped actual ps instance with a verified live timing window for the signal attempt.
controls.intended_cleanup: Exact owned ps child KILL followed by bounded exact-child reap, without signalling an unrelated or already reaped PID.
controls.limitation: Installed executable metadata and successful ordinary ps queries do not establish KILL delivery.

controls.name: genuine-uid-denial-and-permission-unknown
controls.missing_prerequisite: A separately authorised privileged owner to create and clean a fixture whose real and effective UIDs both differ from the sender UIDs.
controls.intended_denial: Actual kernel EPERM, with a separate missing-table condition requiring permission_unknown.
controls.intended_cleanup: The separately authorised fixture owner terminates and exactly reaps its own child.
operations_not_attempted: real denial combined with missing table
controls.limitation: Injected errno and zombie observations do not establish real UID-based denial.
